title: Ethan in Florida
intro: I'm in Florida Nov 26 through Dec 9, mostly in Jacksonville with a festival weekend in Boca. Catch me at one of these public events or set some time up with me on the side ;)

events.title: Shuffle & Flow Under the Bridge
events.description: Shuffle dancing and flow arts under the Fuller Warren Bridge, hosted by Flowstate Syndicate. Bring a prop or your dancing shoes, or just come hang out by the river.
events.image_alt: Map of Riverside Arts Market under the Fuller Warren Bridge on the St. Johns River

events.title: Flow night
events.description: Flow arts meetup under the Fuller Warren Bridge. Bring a prop and play, learn something new, or just come sit by the river and watch. Free, no ticket.
events.image_alt: Map of Riverside Arts Market under the Fuller Warren Bridge on the St. Johns River

events.title: Cyclops Cove 4
events.description: Three-day bass music festival from Bassrush. 18+ and ticketed, with three-day passes and single days. I'll be there all weekend.
